content: 1. Pemigatinib metabolism is influenced by hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the pemigatinib dose as per the drug monograph dosage modifications. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor for three elimination half-lives, the previous pemigatinib dose may be resumed. 2. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of pexidartinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the pexidartinib dose as per the drug monograph dosage modifications. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor for three elimination half-lives, the previous pexidartinib dose may be resumed. 3. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of pimozide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of QT interval prolongation. 4. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of ranolazine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 5. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of repotrectinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Discontinue strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors and wait 3–5 elimination half-lives before initiating repotrectinib. 6. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 7. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 8. Ritonavir increases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 9. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of selumetinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors cannot be avoided, reduce the selumetinib dosage as per the drug monograph. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor for three elimination half-lives, resume the previous selumetinib dose. 10. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of silodosin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 11. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of simvastatin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 12. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of siponimod by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Coadministration of siponimod with a moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitor plus a moderate or strong CYP2C9 inhibitor is not recommended. 13. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of sirolimus by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 14. St. John’s Wort decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 15. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration of tazemetostat with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the tazemetostat dose as per the drug monograph. 16. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 17. Tovorafenib decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration of tovorafenib (a weak CYP3A4 inducer) with CYP3A substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious therapeutic failures. If unavoidable, monitor patients for loss of efficacy unless otherwise recommended in the CYP3A4 substrate prescribing information. 18. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of venetoclax by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If a moderate CYP3A inhibitor must be used, reduce the venetoclax dose by at least 50%. Monitor closely for signs of venetoclax toxicities. 19. Aprepitant increases the levels of vilazodone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If intolerable adverse effects occur when coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors, reduce the daily dose to 20 mg. 20. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of acalabrutinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Decrease the acalabrutinib dose to 100 mg once daily if coadministered with a moderate CYP3A inhibitor. 21. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of almotriptan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 22. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of alprazolam by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 23. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of amiodarone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 24. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of amitriptyline by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 25. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of aripiprazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 26. Armodafinil decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 27. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of artemether/lumefantrine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 28. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 29. Aprepitant decreases the levels or effects of atogepant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 30. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of atorvastatin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 31. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of avanafil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. CYP3A4 inhibitors may reduce avanafil clearance, increasing systemic exposure and associated adverse events. The maximum recommended dose of STENDRA is 50 mg, not to exceed once every 24 hours for patients taking concomitant moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 32. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 33. Belzutifan decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. If unable to avoid coadministration of belzutifan with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates, consider increasing the sensitive CYP3A4 substrate dose in accordance with its prescribing information. 34. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of bexarotene by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Altered bexarotene serum concentrations may occur, leading to either an increased risk of bexarotene-related adverse reactions or a risk of decreased bexarotene efficacy. 35. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of bortezomib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 36. Bosentan decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 37. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of brexpiprazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Administer a quarter of the brexpiprazole dose if coadministered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor plus a strong/moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor. 38. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of budesonide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Budesonide decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 39. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of buprenorphine subdermal implant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Monitor patients already on buprenorphine subdermal implant who require newly initiated treatment with CYP3A4 inhibitors for signs and symptoms of overmedication. If the dose of the concomitant CYP3A4 inhibitor cannot be reduced or discontinued, implant removal may be necessary, and the patient should then be treated with a buprenorphine dosage form that permits dose adjustments. If a CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued in a patient stabilized on buprenorphine, monitor the patient for withdrawal. 40. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of buprenorphine long-acting injection by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Patients who transfer to buprenorphine long-acting injection from transmucosal buprenorphine coadministered with CYP3A4 inhibitors should be monitored to ensure buprenorphine plasma levels are adequate. Within two weeks, if signs and symptoms of buprenorphine toxicity or overdose occur and the concomitant CYP3A4 inhibitor cannot be reduced or discontinued, transition the patient back to a buprenorphine formulation that permits dose adjustments. 41. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of buspirone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 42. Butabarbital decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 43. Butalbital decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 44. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of cabazitaxel by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Caution should be exercised with concomitant use of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 45. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of cabozantinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 46. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of cannabidiol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Consider reducing the cannabidiol dose when coadministered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. 47. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of capivasertib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Reduce the capivasertib dose if coadministered with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. 48. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of carbamazepine by decreasing metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Monitor plasma levels when used concomitantly. 49. Cenobamate decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrate, as needed, when coadministered with cenobamate. 50. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of cilostazol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 51. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of cinacalcet by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 52. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of clomipramine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 53. Aprepitant decreases the levels or effects of clopidogrel by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Inhibition of CYP3A4 will reduce clopidogrel bioactivation. 54. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of clozapine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 55. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of conivaptan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 56. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 57. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens (vaginal) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 58. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of cortisone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Cortisone decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 59. Aprepitant increases the levels of crizotinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Crizotinib increases the levels of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Caution should be exercised with concomitant use of moderate CYP3A inhibitors. 60. Crofelemer increases the levels of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Crofelemer has the potential to inhibit CYP3A4 at concentrations expected in the gut; it is unlikely to inhibit systemically because it is minimally absorbed. 61. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of cyclosporine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Cyclosporine increases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 62. Dabrafenib decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. 63. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of daridorexant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Daridorexant dose should not exceed 25 mg per night when coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 64. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of darifenacin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Darifenacin increases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 65. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of darunavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 66. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of dasatinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 67. Deferasirox decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 68. Aprepitant increases the levels or effects of deflazacort by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Decrease the deflazacort dose to one-third of the recommended dose if coadministered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.
